review_candidates.title: IT Systems Engineer L1
review_candidates.description_excerpt: In this role, you will act as a key technical contact, diagnosing, troubleshooting, and resolving software-related issues for our client and their end-users. You will ensure seamless operations by providing high-quality software support, system troubleshooting, and technical assistance, helping users maintain maximum productivity while working across modern hybrid environments. Key Responsibilities ● Remote Support & Incident Resolution: Deliver remote technical support via enterprise ticketing
eligibility_evidence: About the Job As an IT Systems Engineer - Hybrid at Nexus Tech Support , you will be dedicated to supporting one of our premier clients—a leading Big 5 insurance enterprise in the United States .

You will ensure seamless operations by providing high-quality software support, system troubleshooting, and technical assistance, helping users maintain maximum productivity while working across modern hybrid environments.
● Diagnostic Troubleshooting: Diagnose and resolve complex software anomalies, application crashes, profile corruptions, and operating system errors across virtual and hybrid user environments.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Requirements & Qualifications ● Education & Experience: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience), with 1–2 years of hands-on experience in technical support, help desk, or IT operations. ● Virtualization Fundamentals: Good foundational knowledge of virtualization technologies, with preferred familiarity or hands-on exposure to VMware environments.
